resources.string: Paused while the screen is off
Allows Ankiconnect Android to open AnkiDroid\'s card browser.
Automatically start the server after the device restarts.
Off: the server only listens on this device (127.0.0.1). On: other devices on the same Wi-Fi can reach it. The server reopens automatically when this changes.
Pause server when screen is off
Stops listening while the screen is off to save battery and resumes when the screen turns back on. Requests made with the screen off will fail.
Battery optimization is on. Disable it so the server is less likely to be paused or killed in the background.
Battery optimization is off. The server can keep running in the background.
Notifications are disabled, so import progress and the result won\'t be shown. A message will still appear when it finishes; enable notifications in system settings for the full view.
Sets the language to use for Forvo audio.
Select the android.db generated by the desktop local audio add-on. No adb or file manager needed.
Import started. You can leave the app; progress is shown in the notification.
Removes the imported database to free up space.
The imported android.db will be deleted. You can import it again later.
This app uses a persistent notification to inform you that the server is running. Please enable notifications to see this.
